approved: Social Security Legislation Amendment (Disaster Recovery Allowance) Bill 2013

Supported the Social Security Legislation Amendment (Disaster Recovery Allowance) Bill 2013, which would replace the disaster income recovery subsidy with a 13-week payment from 1 October this year; outlined a proposal for small businesses to access loans up to $100,000 at four per cent for up to seven years, plus tax relief.

Supported the Disaster Recovery Allowance bill and questioned the proposed small-business commitment of up to $100,000 loans at four per cent, citing disaster impacts in Queensland and seeking details of offsets for the financial commitment.

Announced that the Disaster Recovery Allowance would replace the ex gratia Disaster Income Recovery Subsidy, providing legislated support with clear eligibility, activation, review, fraud and debt-recovery processes for people whose incomes are affected by fire, cyclone or flood, with preparatory work targeted for the 2013-14 summer.
Social Security Legislation Amendment (Disaster Recovery Allowance) Act 2013
